warningOriginal.text: 发动机冷却液温度过高，请安全停车并联系服务店

excludedNearMatches.publicTitleZh: P011700 冷却液温度传感器1电路电压过低
excludedNearMatches.reasonToAcquirePage: Check whether sensor-circuit failure has a documented warning fallback.
excludedNearMatches.whyNotEquivalent: Circuit voltage too low is not coolant temperature too high.

excludedNearMatches.publicTitleZh: P011800 发动机冷却液温度传感器电路电压过高
excludedNearMatches.reasonToAcquirePage: Check whether sensor-circuit failure has a documented warning fallback.
excludedNearMatches.whyNotEquivalent: Circuit voltage too high is not coolant temperature too high.

groups.headingOnlyConclusion: No heading explicitly naming actual engine-coolant overtemperature was found in the 496 engine headings. Sensor electrical faults cannot be substituted for warning 0x1E.
missingOriginalEvidence: ECM diagnostic introduction DTA1343324 / outline_22_a and fault list DTA1343330 / outline_25_a, with CALID/software applicability.

The original warning-trigger/engine-overheat message specification: temperature threshold, enable/debounce/recovery, sensor-invalid fallback and an explicit association with CAN 0x261 warning ID 0x1E. Its document locator is not known.

warningOriginal.text: 机油压力不足，请安全停车并联系服务店

excludedNearMatches.publicTitleZh: ​P052200 机油压力传感器电路电压/占空比偏低
excludedNearMatches.reasonToAcquirePage: Check sensor electrical detection and documented system reaction.
excludedNearMatches.whyNotEquivalent: Low sensor voltage/duty cycle is not proof of mechanically low oil pressure.

excludedNearMatches.publicTitleZh: ​P052300 机油压力传感器电路电压/占空比偏高
excludedNearMatches.reasonToAcquirePage: Check sensor electrical detection and documented system reaction.
excludedNearMatches.whyNotEquivalent: High sensor voltage/duty cycle is not proof of mechanically low oil pressure.

groups.headingOnlyConclusion: No engine heading explicitly naming actual low lubrication pressure was found. P052200/P052300 are excluded electrical near matches, not assigned to warning 0x20.
missingOriginalEvidence: Original P052200 / outline_490_a and P052300 / outline_489_a detection-and-system-reaction pages, only to distinguish circuit faults from pressure detection.

An applicable oil-pressure-warning specification associating the pressure-switch/sensor condition, engine-speed/time gates and CAN 0x261 warning ID 0x20. DTC storage may be independent; locator unknown.

warningOriginal.text: 电池温度高，加速性能下降

semanticCandidates.publicTitleZh: P1A3A22 动力电池单节温度一般过高
semanticCandidates.reasonToAcquirePage: The title explicitly names a traction-battery cell temperature generally too high.
semanticCandidates.whyNotEquivalent: The title does not say reduced acceleration, warning 0x358, sensor aggregation, threshold, hysteresis or recovery.

semanticCandidates.publicTitleZh: P1A3922 动力电池单节温度严重过高
semanticCandidates.reasonToAcquirePage: The title explicitly names a traction-battery cell temperature severely too high.
semanticCandidates.whyNotEquivalent: A severe cell-temperature DTC is not established as the trigger or prerequisite of the high-temperature acceleration warning.

groups.headingOnlyConclusion: These two headings describe actual high cell temperature and are the narrowest semantic acquisition candidates. They remain catalog headings, not OEM definitions or proved warning links.
missingOriginalEvidence: BMS fault list DTA1248942 / outline_763_a plus the original per-code pages at outline_823_a and outline_808_a.
The applicable BMS033 3.48.07 temperature-derating/system-reaction table and the cluster/VCU warning assignment to CAN 0x261 ID 0x358, including thresholds and recovery.

warningOriginal.text: 动力电池电量低，驱动功率受限

excludedNearMatches.publicTitleZh: P1A3821 动力电池单节电压一般过低
excludedNearMatches.reasonToAcquirePage: Keep as a negative control when the original BMS low-energy reaction is examined.
excludedNearMatches.whyNotEquivalent: Low individual-cell voltage is not a low state of charge threshold or the same power-limit reason.

excludedNearMatches.publicTitleZh: P1A3721 动力电池单节电压严重过低
excludedNearMatches.reasonToAcquirePage: Keep as a negative control when the original BMS low-energy reaction is examined.
excludedNearMatches.whyNotEquivalent: Severely low individual-cell voltage is not a low state of charge threshold or the same power-limit reason.

groups.headingOnlyConclusion: No SOC/电量/荷电 heading occurs in the 206 battery headings. No DTC is proposed for the low-energy warning; undervoltage headings are explicitly excluded near matches.
missingOriginalEvidence: An applicable BMS/VCU low-SOC power-derating and warning-assignment page specifying the low-energy threshold/recovery and CAN 0x261 ID 0x5D. No such original page locator is known.
BMS fault list DTA1248942 is a selection/applicability lead only; it cannot establish that a normal low-SOC warning stores any DTC.

semanticCandidates.publicTitleZh: U01D487 前驱动电机控制器与整车控制器通讯故障
semanticCandidates.reasonToAcquirePage: One explicit front-controller to VCU communications-fault page.
semanticCandidates.whyNotEquivalent: A component communications fault is not an explicit four-wheel-drive warning assignment; FMCU reports format 01 and raw/display encoding is also unproved.

semanticCandidates.publicTitleZh: U01D487 发电机控制器与整车控制器通讯故障
semanticCandidates.reasonToAcquirePage: One explicit generator-controller to VCU communications-fault page.
semanticCandidates.whyNotEquivalent: Generator communications do not establish ownership of the four-wheel-drive warning; ISG format 01 raw/display encoding is unproved.

semanticCandidates.publicTitleZh: P1B0313 左后电机控制器与整车控制器通信故障
semanticCandidates.reasonToAcquirePage: One explicit left-rear controller to VCU communications-fault page.
semanticCandidates.whyNotEquivalent: A left-rear communications DTC is not an explicit mapping to the generic four-wheel-drive warning.

semanticCandidates.publicTitleZh: P1B0413 右后电机控制器与整车控制器通信故障
semanticCandidates.reasonToAcquirePage: One explicit right-rear controller to VCU communications-fault page.
semanticCandidates.whyNotEquivalent: A right-rear communications DTC is not an explicit mapping to the generic four-wheel-drive warning.

groups.headingOnlyConclusion: This is a deliberately small communications-family shortlist across the four candidate controller sections. It is not an exhaustive list of causes and does not identify the sender/owner of warning 0x47.
missingOriginalEvidence: Original code pages outline_571_a, outline_607_a, outline_666_a, outline_630_a and their four section fault lists, with supplier/software applicability.
The VCU four-wheel-drive degradation/arbitration matrix or an original controller system-reaction page explicitly naming the same CAN 0x261 warning ID 0x47. Matching a broad label is insufficient.

limits: Filename/selected text extensions only; no archives or arbitrary binary payload decoding.

limitations: This is not a DTC dictionary and does not establish that any selected DTC triggers a selected warning.
Per-code document IDs are unknown; exact public outline locators are preserved, never expanded into guessed protected URLs.
No actual low-SOC or lubrication-pressure DTC is invented from related electrical/undervoltage words.
Catalog coverage and headings are finite observations, not proof that a matching original document does not exist.
Controller identity/software evidence is historical and was not refreshed on the vehicle.
